bar-kappara.name: Bar Kappara
bar-kappara.era: Tanna/Amora · Land of Israel, early 3rd century
bar-kappara.bio: Sage of the Land of Israel at the close of the tannaitic period, a student of Rabbi Yehuda HaNasi.
bar-kappara.prompt: A quick-witted scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard, bright eyes and a faint wry smile, wearing a plain grey wool mantle and answering a question with one hand open; background of a Galilean stone courtyard in afternoon light.
